name: Kare to Kanojo to Kanojo no Chuugi
original_name: 彼と彼女と彼女の忠義
source:
The protagonist, Kantarou's lifestyle is in poverty.

One day he stumbles over a cat and returns to his 6 tatami-mat single room to find someone he'd never seen before there.

[Translated from [url=http://www.noncolor.com/product/karekano/kareinfo.html]the official page[/url]]
